scope: research-only; immutable evidence summaries, not trading instructions

entries.claim: The chronological 70/30 microstructure predictive test reported NO_STABLE_EDGE: 40,992 rows, 28,694 train and 12,298 test; no candidate met stability criteria.
entries.limits: Threshold candidates selected in train, tested chronologically; does not prove no future signal exists.

entries.claim: The causal forecast calibration artifact reports 30,046 scored samples, mean actual net return -11.81 bps, correlation -0.016, and positive rate 2.97% across its scored population.
entries.limits: Population and assumed costs belong to that artifact; do not generalize to all regimes or horizons.

entries.claim: The historical microstructure strategy attribution reports 199 trades and mean net -7.55 bps; all 199 observations are LOW_VOLATILITY, so other regimes are unobserved.
entries.limits: Historical strategy outcome, not a forecast of current conditions.

entries.claim: Agreement between near-term price movement, book imbalance, and trade delta may be informative conditionally.
entries.evidence: Existing feature fields permit testing this idea.
entries.status: unconfirmed; require chronological holdout, calibration, regime slices, and realistic costs.

entries.claim: Do not equate positive order-book imbalance or trade delta with a reliable upward forecast.
entries.evidence: The predictive test found near-zero unconditional feature correlations and no stable candidates.
entries.lesson: Report a weak or abstaining view unless calibrated conditional evidence supports it.

entries.claim: A positive gross future move is not evidence of positive net expectancy.
entries.evidence: Existing research artifacts show negative net outcomes after their specified costs.
entries.lesson: Keep gross labels distinct from net outcomes; identify cost assumptions and uncertainty.

entries.claim: Do not claim a strategy is regime robust from a single-regime sample.
entries.evidence: Failure attribution contains only LOW_VOLATILITY observations.
entries.lesson: Mark unobserved regimes as unknown and abstain from extrapolation.
